pick_implementation.title: Connect your Pantrist account
pick_implementation.description: Authorize Home Assistant to access your Pantrist data.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect your Pantrist account
reauth_confirm.description: Your Pantrist refresh token is no longer valid. Re-authorize to continue receiving updates.

abort.missing_configuration: Pantrist Application Credentials are not set up.
abort.missing_list_id: Pantrist did not return a list ID — please try again and pick a list during the consent step.
abort.already_configured: This Pantrist list is already connected.
abort.wrong_account: The selected list belongs to a different Pantrist account or list than the original entry. Remove this entry and add a new one instead.
abort.invalid_auth: The Pantrist API rejected the access token. Please try again.
abort.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Pantrist API. Please check your connection and try again.

socket_disconnected.title: Pantrist real-time updates interrupted
socket_disconnected.description: The Pantrist Socket.IO connection for list {list_name} has been down for ~{minutes} min. List contents will update again automatically when the connection is restored — no action is needed unless this persists. If it does, check Settings → System → Logs for ``custom_components.pantrist`` errors.

not_configured.message: Pantrist integration is not configured. Add the integration before calling this service.

unknown_list_id.message: No Pantrist coordinator for list_id={list_id}. Available: {available}.

number_set_failed.message: Could not change pantry amount for {name}: {error}

missing_item_identifier.message: Specify the pantry item to change — provide its name or its UUID.

pantry_item_not_found.message: No pantry item matches "{name}". Available items: {available}.

pantry_item_ambiguous.message: Several pantry items match "{name}": {matches}. Re-run with the Item UUID to pick one.

add_to_shopping_list.name: Add to shopping list
add_to_shopping_list.description: Add an item by name to the connected Pantrist shopping list.

add_to_shopping_list_by_barcode.name: Add to shopping list by barcode
add_to_shopping_list_by_barcode.description: Look up a product by barcode and add it to the shopping list.

check_shopping_list_item.name: Check shopping-list item
check_shopping_list_item.description: Mark an item on the shopping list as bought.

item_id.name: Item UUID
item_id.description: The uuid attribute of the item.

delete_shopping_list_item.name: Delete shopping-list item
delete_shopping_list_item.description: Remove an item from the shopping list.

item_id.name: Item UUID
item_id.description: The uuid attribute of the item.

add_to_pantry.name: Add to pantry
add_to_pantry.description: Add an item by name to the connected Pantrist pantry.

delete_pantry_item.name: Delete pantry item
delete_pantry_item.description: Remove an item from the pantry.

item_id.name: Item UUID
item_id.description: The uuid attribute of the item.

change_pantry_item_amount.name: Change pantry item amount
change_pantry_item_amount.description: Adjust the amount of a pantry item by a delta.

name.name: Item name
name.description: Name of the pantry item to change (e.g. "Milk"). Looked up against your current pantry — no UUID needed. Provide either this or the Item UUID.

item_id.name: Item UUID
item_id.description: The uuid attribute of the item (from sensor.pantrist_pantry). Optional — prefer the Item name unless two items share a name.

change.name: Change
change.description: Positive to add, negative to consume.

auto_restock.name: Auto-restock when below minimum
auto_restock.description: Server-side: also add the item to the shopping list when the decrement crosses its minimum. On by default for HA-triggered flows; set to false for bare-decrement use cases.

search_pantry_items.name: Search pantry items
search_pantry_items.description: Look up pantry items and their UUIDs; returns the matches as a response.

query.name: Search query
query.description: Name (or part of a name) to match, case-insensitively. Leave empty to return the whole pantry.
